svg.title: Default deny: a role sees only the tools it has access to
svg.desc: strazad catalogs 41 tools from two MCP servers, demo-tools with 14 and midpoint with 27. The application role demo-tools-readers starts with an empty catalog, because a tool without access does not exist for the role. An administrator gives the role access to four demo-tools tools. Exactly those four appear in its catalog: echo and get-annotated-message are visible, and get-env and get-sum are approve_gated, so a call to them needs approval. The other 37 tools stay out of its catalog.
svg.text: 27 tools, no access row for this role

g.text: A tool without access does not

svg.text: # give the role access to four demo-tools tools
